text:
nora (Docs): Hi team, opened a small PR to add an IKEv2 VPN snippet for Private installs and a short migration note for customers moving KMS from cloud-vault -> onprem HSM. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4221. Can infra + sec glance?

kai (Eng-Platform): Will do. Please include a minimal strongSwan example and a one-liner to verify phase2 SA. Also add a checksum verify step for any offline bundle imports.

ida (Eng-Infra): Draft strongSwan excerpt looks fine. Add a tiny nftables passthrough for ESP and UDP4500 and a note about MTU/DF bit when VPN encapsulates TLS to the HSM.

oscar (Security): Quick: don't publish PSKs or cert content. Recommend using cert-based auth over PSK for production and a short role-blind KMS ACL example (bundle:upload only). I'll add a blurb in the PR.

paul (Support): Real-world: customers sometimes forget to enable IP forwarding on the gateway. Could we add a quick `sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_forward=1` sanity check and a short troubleshooting step: "no connection -> check ESP/4500 in firewall".

link-bot: linkcheck: failed anchor /private/install/vpn-quickstart -> 404.

nora (Docs): Thanks — I'll remove the stale anchor, add the strongSwan + nftables snippets, include `sha256sum --check` before import, add the ip_forward sanity check, and a two-row troubleshooting table (VPN down -> check IP forwarding; HSM TLS fail -> check MTU and packet capture). Pushing an update now, will request final LGTM from @kai @ida @oscar @paul.
